caption:
Wednesday's Sky is Yang Water, The Ocean 🌊 Find your element below.

Your element is the element of the day you were born. Today's big ocean meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yang Water gets a friend day, Yang Metal gets a joy day, Yang Fire feels the pressure.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

Which line hit closest? Comment below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #astrology #zodiac #selfawareness #astrologer #bazi #chinesemetaphysics #fiveelements #humpday
day_line: An ocean on a Horse day. Big waves and fast hooves: good for bold moves and new ideas, easy to overpromise.

lines.Yang Wood: A hunch shows up mid-meeting. Note it down and test it before you share it.
lines.Yin Wood: Someone offers help today. Say yes, then buy them a kopi after.
lines.Yang Fire: Your inbox gets loud today. Clear the hardest one first, then breathe.
lines.Yin Fire: Your boss notices the small stuff today. Keep your notes tidy and on time.
lines.Yang Earth: A side chance pops up today. Ask the real cost before you say yes.
lines.Yin Earth: Good day to sort the bills. Boring work, very nice feeling after.
lines.Yang Metal: Your fun side wins today. Book the makan plan; the spreadsheet can wait.
lines.Yin Metal: You'll want to correct someone today. Say it kindly, in one message.
lines.Yang Water: Your crowd is in sync today. Say yes to the group plan; split the bill fair.
lines.Yin Water: Someone runs with your idea today. Add your name to it and keep going.
